game.name: Split/second Velocity (Russia)
game.desc: Split/Second is an arcade-oriented racing game to be played on Xbox 360. The software plunges you into the heart of a reality TV show where all the tricks are allowed. In addition to the traditional steering wheel shots designed to propel a competitor off the track, you can also trigger devastating events by crashing into certain elements of the scenery. Destroying a huge structure allows you to spread a lot of debris in the path of the other drivers.
